## What I changed

Only one file touched: `AssignOwnerCustomerCode.java`.

- The customerCode now builds as `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`: first three letters of city and lastName upper-cased, plus a **per-city** sequence (one more than the owners already in that city, filtering `findAll()` by matching city).
- Extracted a small private `prefix(...)` helper so both the city and last-name segments reuse the same three-char/upper-case logic, keeping the `service` method simple.

## Why nothing else needed changing

`MembershipNumber.of(...)` already derives its value by reading `owner.getCustomerCode()` and appending `-M<YY>`. Since it composes from the live customerCode rather than re-deriving from lastName, it automatically picks up the new `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` format — no edit required. This kept the change to a single, cohesive function and one file, minimizing structural impact.
